name: RDP / TerminalServices Event Logs
os_min: Windows Vista / Server 2008 (channel structure); RDP itself much older
purpose: Records the network-connection, authentication, and session-lifecycle stages of RDP activity across three separate log channels.
key_fields: Event ID 4624/4625 with Logon Type 10 or 7 (Security)
normal_baseline: RDP sessions correspond to known admin jump-box or remote-work sources at expected times.
anomalies: Session Event ID 25 (reconnect) shortly after an unexplained disconnect
4625 failures preceding a successful 4624/1149 pair (possible brute force then success)
anti_forensic_notes: 1149's description ('User authentication succeeded') is misleading, it reflects successful network-level authentication, not a completed interactive logon; correlating across all three channels (within about 1 minute tolerance) is needed for a complete session timeline.
